text:
maya: Quick async check — where are we on the Optimize toolkit deliverables? Need: final quant recs doc, default batching/caching params, and regression-alert wiring before the rollout. Who's owning each?

adrian: I own quant recs PR, see https://github.com/redwood-inference/opt-kit/pull/842 — waiting on perf sweep results.

sam: Perf sweep running, preliminary numbers look promising: ~8–10% token cost reduction on llama-2-13b using int8 + per-layer clamp. No accuracy regressions on our small eval set. Logs: `s3://rwdn-perf/optkit/sweeps/842/summary.txt`.

jen: I can take canary for caching in EU region (eu-west-1). Will monitor SLA and error rates.

luke: Infra note — for canary I need exact model variant names + fallback list so routing rules can be updated. Also need service account for canary.

ci-bot: CI check passed for opt-kit PR #842 (all tests green).

maya: Awesome. @sam — can you paste the minimal local run command + expected metrics we should look at for the canary?

sam: Sure — here's a quick run I use locally:

```
# quick local eval (batch=4)
curl -X POST https://local-optkit-test/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"llama-2-13b-int8","batch_size":4,"prompt":"<checkout_flow_prompt>"}' 
# expect: p95 latency < 220ms, tokens/sec ~ 120-140, cost/unit down ~9% vs baseline
```

adrian: I'll wait for the final sweep numbers then merge. ETA: today EOD PST. Once merged i'll add the regression alert webhook to the quality dashboard — tagging @jen for canary signoff.

jen: Approved for canary :thumbsup:. I'll watch latency p95 and error spike. Please send the canary traffic window.

luke: Infra request: whitelist service account `opt-tooling-canary@infra.redwood` in eu-west-1 VPC, and allocate one spare c-type node for 2 hours starting at rollout.

maya: Can someone add the checklist to the milestone? (quant doc link, PR merged, infra whitelist, dashboard rule, canary window). If no blockers, propose rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

adrian: Adding checklist now. Also wiring alert rule: threshold delta >3% perplexity OR latency spike >50ms over baseline — will post rule id when done.

sam: No perf blockers from my side. I’ll keep an eye during canary and post any anomalies.

jen: I'll post canary window in #incidents and invite SRE on-call.

maya: Great — final quick question: who owns follow-up action to backfill docs on recommended quant profiles per model size?

adrian: I’ll do short doc update in the repo after merge (one-pager + table).

luke: Done on infra side — whitelisting scheduled, node reserved for 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

maya: Perfect. Thanks all — marking this thread as the delivery handshake. :white_check_mark:
